Noah (growth): Need a compact external one-pager tying deploy modes to SLA promises + clear inbound routing for field. Target: infra leads/CISOs.
Esha (product): Agree. Sections: Why SLA matters, Deploy-mode snapshot (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), Verified perf blurb, How to engage (routing + PoC).
Ben (eng): External benchmark line: "Typical verified p95 for a 2k gen: Hosted ~270ms, Dedicated ~200ms (reserved), Private: varies; request your workload test." Thumbs-up to conservative wording.
Tara (field): Routing: form tags -> secure_eval / sla_request / private_interest. secure_eval -> AE-security; private_interest -> solutions-eng + auto support ticket. Flag regulated sectors as high-priority.
Mina (design): I'll produce a one-pager PDF with a hero 3-column micro-table + 3 icons (SLA, Data Controls, Cost). Deliver by EOD tomorrow.
Noah (growth): Webinar hook: "SLA Patterns for Secure Inference". CTA: Download, Request benchmark, Register. Distribution: landing page -> blog -> socials -> webinar -> SDR seq.
LegalBot: Reminder: submit one-pager for legal review before publish.
Esha (product): Action items: Ben - confirm benchmark line; Mina - mock; Tara - routing mapping; Noah - draft copy. Keep <350 words."
